name: Kidney growth restraint and mesenchymal cell survival
rationale: All members restrain kidney/metanephros growth, size or proliferation or block developmental mesenchymal apoptosis; the anti-apoptotic mesenchymal members are what the overlapping kidney-proliferation confusables lack.

name: MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Every member is a MET (HGF receptor) event, from effector activation (RAS, PI3K, STAT3, PTPN11, RAP1/RAC1, PTK2) to recycling and drug inhibition, unlike the PTK6/ALK and integrin-adhesion confusables.

name: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signaling and costimulatory/coinhibitory control
rationale: Members cover proximal TCR and BCR signaling plus CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 coinhibition and receptor-signal brakes, spanning both T and B cells whereas confusables are T-activation-only or B-differentiation-only.

qualifier: AMPA/kainate receptors and presynaptic modulation of release
name: AMPA/kainate transmission and presynaptic modulation of neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members concern AMPA/kainate receptor activation and clustering together with presynaptic G-protein, calcium and vesicle-fusion control of glutamate/GABA release, distinguishing it from NMDA/LTP, inhibitory-synapse assembly and generic release-cycle confusables.

name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling from destruction complex to TCF/LEF
rationale: All members regulate canonical Wnt signaling at the level of DVL/destruction-complex (AXIN, APC) and beta-catenin-TCF/LEF target transcription, whereas confusables centre on receptor-level control, ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt.

core: Suppression of T cell-associated cytokine production
name: Suppression of IL-2/IL-21/IL-6 production and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members negatively regulate IL-2, IL-21, IL-6 and TNF-superfamily cytokine production and Treg differentiation (with activated T cell proliferation), distinct from IL-10/IL-12, TLR/NF-kB and Treg-promoting confusables.

qualifier: kidney, lung, glands and reproductive tract
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal organogenesis of kidney, lung, glands and reproductive tract
rationale: Members describe branching and epithelial-mesenchymal development of kidney, lung, mammary, prostate, salivary, pancreatic and genital/reproductive tract organs, unlike the gonad, axial/HOX patterning, glomerular filtration and heart development confusables.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation, proliferation and hypertrophy
rationale: All members concern chondroblast/chondrocyte condensation, differentiation, proliferation and hypertrophic maturation, while the confusables are osteoblast- and ossification-centred.
Members split into unrelated magnesium transport/homeostasis, inositol transport/metabolism and generic protein homo/hetero-oligomerization terms, with no shared biological process.

name: Intramembranous ossification, osteoblast development and tendon formation
rationale: Members cover direct ossification, cranial suture and trabecular bone formation, osteoblast development and tendon development, distinguishing it from chondrocyte/RUNX2 and osteoblast-proliferation-regulation confusables.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransporters and Na+/H+ exchangers with inherited defects
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and sodium/proton exchange, including inherited defects
rationale: Members centre on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers, potassium channels and their disease variants plus related ion homeostasis, unlike the bicarbonate/SLC26 anion-exchange and renal sodium/osmotic confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and AURKA/PLK1 activation at G2/M
rationale: Members concern centrosome protein recruitment, centrosome separation, centriole control and AURKA/PLK1/NEK kinase activation at mitotic entry, versus broader spindle/checkpoint/cytokinesis and spindle-orientation confusables.

name: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate nucleocytoplasmic transport
rationale: Members cover NPC assembly, disassembly and postmitotic reformation plus inositol phosphate transport through the pore, which the nuclear-envelope and protein/RNA-export confusables lack.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative ATP synthesis
rationale: Members regulate cellular respiration, electron transport, oxidative phosphorylation and ATP/nucleotide synthesis, distinct from the oxidative-stress-induced cell death confusables.

name: Antral follicle growth and oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: Members concern antral follicle growth and regulation of oocyte meiotic maturation, separating it from germ-cell, ovulation/luteinization and testis confusables.

qualifier: condensation, sister chromatid cohesion and centromere
name: Chromosome condensation, sister chromatid cohesion and mitotic spindle function
rationale: Members cover chromosome condensation, cohesin loading/resolution, CENP-A centromere assembly, spindle assembly/checkpoint and PLK1/AURKA mitotic control, whereas confusables focus on cytokinesis, abscission and nuclear envelope resealing.

core: Suppression of effector T cell responses
name: Suppression of effector T cell responses, favouring Treg differentiation
rationale: Members negatively regulate T cell proliferation, activation, Th1/Th17 and IFN/IL-2 cytokine output while promoting regulatory T cell differentiation, unlike Th1-promoting, dendritic-cell/tolerance, Treg-inhibiting and NK confusables.

name: Sarcomere filament assembly and muscle stretch sensing
rationale: Members concern myosin and thin filament organization, myofibril assembly and stretch detection, unlike the heart morphogenesis, myogenesis and adhesion/cytoskeleton confusables.

name: Oxidative/hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis via mitochondrial permeabilization
rationale: Members regulate peroxide-, oxidative- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis through MOMP, cytochrome c release, BAD and mitochondrial membrane potential, which the oxidative-stress confusables lack.

name: SLIT-ROBO repulsive signaling in commissural axon midline guidance
rationale: All members concern ROBO receptor signaling to RHOA/RAC1/CDC42/ABL and its role in commissural midline crossing, distinguishing it from netrin, ephrin, L1 and retinal axon guidance confusables.

name: Nuclear RNA surveillance and decay
rationale: Members are nuclear RNA decay and surveillance of mRNA, snRNA and cryptic unstable transcripts, unlike cytoplasmic decapping/deadenylation, mRNA export and RNA 3'-end processing confusables.

qualifier: survival, maintenance and epithelial tubule differentiation
name: Metanephric mesenchyme survival, maintenance and epithelial tubule differentiation
rationale: Members cover metanephric mesenchyme progenitor maintenance, anti-apoptosis and growth restraint plus its mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion into nephron tubules, unlike ureteric bud, nephric duct and nephron-segment confusables.

name: DNA double-strand break sensing and NHEJ/HR repair pathway choice
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM signaling, classical and alternative end joining, regulation of HR versus NHEJ and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects, whereas confusables emphasize end resection/Fanconi/PARylation, replication stress and telomeres.

qualifier: dengue and RSV attachment, entry and assembly
name: Enveloped RNA virus attachment, entry and dengue virion assembly
rationale: Members concern host-cell entry and promotion of the viral life cycle, exemplified by dengue and RSV, unlike viral protein maturation, influenza endocytic entry and host restriction confusables.

name: Mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, ESCRT-III resealing and abscission
rationale: Members cover lamina depolymerization, nuclear membrane disassembly and reassembly, ESCRT-III sealing and midbody abscission, unlike the nuclear pore complex and contractile ring confusables.
